name: Supreme court
description: Follow Supreme court, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump gets a big win at the Supreme Court and the NBA hands out a massive punishment: The news quiz
changes.summary: A former congressman got hit with a ban, an artist had his upcoming Met Gala exhibition pulled, and a record carrier deployment finally came to an end.

changes.title: Missouri Asks Supreme Court to Allow Voting Map Benefiting Republicans
changes.summary: Missouri’s Supreme Court said a map redrawn to help Republicans could not be used in November and said voters should decide on the new boundaries.

changes.title: Supreme Court Sides With Republicans in TV Ad Fight
changes.summary: Republican groups had asked the court to clear the way for political parties to pay the same low-cost ad rates as candidates, a move that could undercut a Democratic advantage in the midterms.

changes.title: Judge Once Again Blocks Trump Administration’s Plans to Restrict Mail-In Ballots
changes.summary: The ruling arrived before the Supreme Court could decide whether to intervene but appeared certain to set off yet another round of appeals.

changes.title: Election expert on the impact of Trump's appeal to SCOTUS on mail-in ballots
changes.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks David Becker, an elections administration expert, what effect the Trump administration's appeal to the Supreme Court on mail-in ballots could have on the midterms.

changes.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to weigh in on mail-in ballots
changes.summary: Mail ballots are now being sent to certain states as questions linger about new restrictions ahead of the midterms. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi reports.

changes.title: North Carolina Set to Mail The Fall’s First Ballots As Trump Tries to Restrict Them
changes.summary: A federal judge has temporarily blocked a Postal Service rule that could impede millions of mail voters. The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court to weigh in.

changes.title: Missouri's top court blocks new House map favoring GOP until voters can weigh in
changes.summary: The Missouri Supreme Court has blocked a new House map backed by President Trump from being used in the November election, a setback in Republicans' efforts to pick up an additional House seat.

changes.title: DOJ asks Supreme Court to allow Postal Service rules on mail ballots
changes.summary: The Justice Department asked the Supreme Court to intervene in an ongoing legal battle over U.S. Postal Service rules for mail ballots just weeks before the November midterm elections.

changes.title: Trump again appeals to Supreme Court on mail voting restrictions as midterms loom
changes.summary: The Trump administration on Thursday asked the Supreme Court to reject an order by a federal judge that halts it from implementing a new rule regulating mail ballots, hours after being unable to tell that judge whether the computer system that would govern the entire project was operational yet.
